inference_template.decision_basis: The user reports a gift card deposit and an evening deadline after a video tour; the sources say not to pay by gift card, to walk away from pressure and to report the ad.

source_conversation.content: I'm thinking about renting a condo the ad says is near the university.
Look at the property before you sign or pay, in person, through someone you trust, or via a video or virtual tour.
I toured it on a video call with the agent. Then he asked me to send a $600 deposit by gift card so the unit is held, and he says I have to decide by tonight.

sections.text: Any device: Don't send money by wire transfer, gift card, or cryptocurrency, since these work like cash and are usually unrecoverable. If someone insists on wire transfers through Western Union or MoneyGram, gift cards, or cryptocurrency, treat it as a scam.
Any device: Be suspicious if the rent is far below local rents. If anyone pressures you to make a decision quickly, walk away.
Any device: Report the scam to your local law enforcement agency and to the website where the ad appeared. Report it to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov (https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/#/).
